description: Tunable brain model parameters for evolutionary search. Each numeric parameter declares [min, max, default]; the mutator samples Gaussian noise clipped to the range.

exploration.turn_bias.description: Novelty-driven turn bias multiplier injected into CX goal columns. Higher = stronger response to fresher ground.

exploration.bold_explore_stuck_s.description: Seconds of stuck before forced bold-explore (breakout) activates. Lower = faster breakout but more erratic.

exploration.revisit_penalty_scale.description: Weight of revisit_penalty in health_score. Higher = more aggressive avoidance of familiar ground.

exploration.gate_forward_threshold.description: Forward pool firing rate gate (Hz). Lower = easier to trigger forward motion.

exploration.gate_jump_threshold.description: Jump pool firing rate gate (Hz). Lower = jump triggers more easily.

exploration.cliff_tangent_gain.description: How strongly the cliff tangent bias influences turn pools. 0 = disable detour, 3 = strong swerve.

exploration.loop_breakout_threshold.description: loop_score above this activates forced escape behavior when stuck. Lower = escape from milder loops.

exploration.stuck_ramp_cooldown.description: Seconds stuck_ramp reflex stays suppressed after firing. Longer = less reflex thrashing.

exploration.visual_gain_novelty_boost.description: Sensor gain boost per unit novelty (applied at model.step). Positive = stronger response to novel visual input.

exploration.dopamine_revisit_cost.description: Dopamine punishment threshold for revisit_penalty. Higher = MB learns faster to avoid loops.

exploration.breakout_forward_bias.description: Fraction of forward drive during escape behavior (vs. turning). Higher = straighter breakout runs.
